claim.title: crypto venue outage、pre-market 和 clawback 风险必须单独审计
claim.statement: Crypto perpetual 项目必须单独审计交易所维护/服务中断、API/WebSocket 断连、heartbeat/ping-pong 失败、stream 限流、mark price / index price 异常监控、预上市 perpetual、ADL/insurance-fund 事件和交易所特定 loss-allocation 机制；不得把 24/7 连续交易假设等同于无停机、无断连、无数据缺口或无交易所机制风险。
claim.evidence_summary: Databento status schema 支撑市场状态字段；Binance / Bybit WebSocket 文档支撑断连、heartbeat、限流和连接有效期风险；Binance maintenance updates 支撑维护窗口来源；Binance Mark Price API 支撑 mark/index 监控字段；Binance ADL 与 insurance fund 来源支撑交易所特定 loss-allocation 机制。
claim.interpretation_notes: 本候选只定义 crypto perpetual 风险和数据边界，不输出交易参数、仓位、杠杆、清算规避建议或实盘执行许可。

applies_when: 外接项目涉及 crypto perpetual、永续合约、USDT/coin margined futures、funding、liquidation、ADL 或 crypto venue outage 风险。
AI IDE 需要区分 mark/index/last price、funding fee、price PnL、手续费、清算和 ADL/insurance fund 机制。
需要检查 crypto perpetual 知识是否被错误泛化到传统期货、股票、现货或普通回测规则。
not_applicable_when: 用户要求具体仓位、杠杆、止损止盈、清算规避、交易许可或实盘操作。
需要某个账户、交易所或产品的实时保证金、清算线、费率、funding 或 ADL 状态时，应由外接项目事实层提供。
需要合规、法律、税务、托管或资金安全结论时，应由对应 owner 判断。
assumptions: Crypto perpetual 是 venue-specific 高风险产品，所有机制必须绑定交易所、产品、保证金模式、抵押资产和规则版本。
官方交易所/平台来源只能证明自身规则，不得泛化为全市场标准。
候选通过外部审计前不能进入 formal reviewed 知识库。
limitations: Crypto 交易所规则、API 字段、funding 间隔、清算和 ADL 机制变化快，正式 reviewed 前必须由审计确认活跃版本。
候选不包含任何项目私有账户、密钥、风险阈值、交易参数或实盘状态。
本候选不能替代外接项目的实时风控、交易所连接、账户同步和人工风险审批。
本候选将 clawback 收窄为 exchange-specific loss-allocation mechanism；若外接项目使用特定 clawback 术语，必须补对应 venue rulebook。
Binance / Bybit / OKX / Databento 来源只能证明各自平台、API 或 schema 语境，不能泛化为所有 crypto venue。

source_refs.evidence_summary: Databento status schema covers trading status, halt, pause, auction, matching-engine status and instrument expiration events.
limitations: General market-status schema support; not a crypto venue outage or clawback policy source.

source_refs.evidence_summary: OKX describes pre-market perpetuals, no expiration/delivery and early trading before official listing or spot launch.
limitations: Pre-market product-specific; not all perpetuals share the same listing, index or settlement risks.

source_refs.evidence_summary: Binance states ADL is the final step in liquidation and occurs if futures insurance funds cannot accept a bankrupt position.
limitations: Binance ADL process; not a universal loss-socialization model.

source_refs.evidence_summary: Binance describes futures insurance funds as safety nets that limit the impact of liquidations and bankrupt positions.
limitations: Binance insurance-fund design; not a universal guarantee or solvency proof.

source_refs.evidence_summary: Binance states aggregate trade streams include only market trades and exclude insurance fund and ADL trades.
limitations: API stream detail; outage/incident truth still needs exchange status and project logs.

source_refs.source_title: Binance USDⓈ-M Futures WebSocket Market Streams
source_refs.evidence_summary: Binance WebSocket market streams document ping/pong, disconnect behavior, message limits and stream limits.
limitations: Binance-specific API behavior; not universal to all crypto venues.

source_refs.source_title: Binance Futures WebSocket API General Info
source_refs.evidence_summary: Binance WebSocket API notes that a single connection is valid for 24 hours and ping/pong failure leads to disconnection.
limitations: Binance WebSocket API context; not a full outage incident source.

source_refs.evidence_summary: Binance publishes scheduled maintenance and upgrade notices that can affect services.
limitations: Announcement list; incident-specific evidence still depends on the exact event notice.

source_refs.evidence_summary: Bybit recommends sending ping heartbeat packets every 20 seconds to maintain WebSocket connections.
limitations: Bybit-specific connectivity guidance; not a universal outage policy.

source_refs.evidence_summary: Binance Mark Price API exposes markPrice, indexPrice, lastFundingRate, nextFundingTime and time, supporting mark-price monitoring fields.
limitations: Does not by itself define all mark-price anomaly handling rules.

source_refs.evidence_summary: OKX status page provides service-status and incident/maintenance context for exchange availability checks.
limitations: OKX-specific; not Binance/Bybit global outage truth.

source_refs.source_title: Mark Price Calculation (Perpetual and Expiry Contracts)
source_refs.evidence_summary: Bybit mark price documentation includes mark/index calculation context and abnormal/fallback handling cues for index components.
limitations: Bybit-specific; other venues need their own mark/index abnormal handling rules.

source_refs.source_title: Binance Statement on Recent Market Volatility
source_refs.evidence_summary: Binance official announcement provides incident-style context for service stability and market-volatility reviews.
limitations: Event-specific announcement; not a standing status-page API.
